skill_name: Write an essay about what makes a good leader.
workflow: A good leader has many qualities, but the ten most important traits a leader must have are confidence, integrity, decisiveness, communication, commitment, courage, empathy, optimism, a willingness to learn, and trustworthiness. A leader with confidence in their abilities and those of the people around them is more likely to inspire and encourage others to work towards a shared goal.
